purpose: Golden-20 OpenRouter extraction evaluation. To change the model, edit ONLY the two model settings in this one file: put the model's key in active_model, or add a new OpenRouter model id under models and point active_model at it. Nothing else needs to move.

model_notes.particle-1: Free. Supports strict JSON schema and explicitly supports reasoning effort none. Verified against the OpenRouter model list on 2026-11-26.
model_notes.nemotron-3.5-super-vl: Free. Supports strict JSON schema and reasoning can be turned off. Verified against the OpenRouter model list on 2026-11-26. Vision-capable; text works fine.
model_notes.ernie-5.5-flash: Free. Strict JSON schema declared on its serving endpoint and reasoning effort none supported. Verified against the OpenRouter model list and endpoint list on 2026-11-27.

reasoning_note: If a model rejects effort none, stop and report it; switch this to {"enabled": false} only as a deliberate config change, never silently. Do not just delete the key, or the model may spend hidden reasoning tokens.
chunk_limit_note: Set to 2 for the first live smoke check, then back to null for the full 20-chunk run.
cost_note: All listed models are free-tier, so cost_usd is expected to be provider-reported 0. When both sides of a comparison are free, there is no dollar saving to measure; compare tokens, latency, schema pass and extraction quality instead.

telemetry.note: Off by default. To watch traces: pip install -r requirements-observability.txt, start Phoenix with `phoenix serve`, then set enabled to true. Extraction never depends on Phoenix; spans carry metadata only, never chunk text, prompts or keys. metrics.jsonl stays the durable record.
